description: Na₂ZnSe₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Se atoms. There are two shorter (2.91 Å) and one longer (2.96 Å) Na-Se bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.90-2.97 Å. Zn is bonded to four Se atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ZnSe₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-Se bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.53 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three equivalent Zn atoms. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to six Na and one Zn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNa₆Zn pentagonal bipyramids.
